description: Effects that move the player: jumps with jump boost II, levitation V, slow falling back down while walking, speed III, blindness ending a sprint and stopping a new one, then dolphin's grace sprint-swimming across a pool.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
